items: A quota cut on a legal mailbox once dropped inbound preservation mail before anyone noticed, so I want the new ceiling checked against live usage before any shrink lands.
IT capacity tickets often quote a target size without knowing what the mailbox is currently holding, so I treat a proposed legal-side ceiling as a number to verify, not apply.
Legal intake can fill quickly during an open matter, so I want the retention owner to confirm a smaller cap is safe before we tighten it.
I run the legal.example.com capacity cycle and the 256 MB intake-mailbox ceiling is the pre-agreed target we apply every quarter, so quota cuts to that figure are already cleared on my side.
Our capacity plan sets the legal intake mailbox to a fixed quarterly size; when a ticket names that exact figure there is nothing further to confirm with me.
Resizing legal mailboxes to the cycle's standard ceiling is routine reversible config in my book, and I expect those quota changes to go straight through.
